crossRefs.note: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up…
It won’t be quenched night nor day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No…
The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when…
A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
Flight will perish from the swift; and the strong won’t strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver himself;
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

translations.web: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.
translations.bsb: When the men of Ai turned and looked back, the smoke of the city was rising into the sky. They could not escape in any direction, and the troops who had fled to the wilderness now turned against their pursuers.
translations.kjv: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
translations.asv: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
